summary: Neighbors in {building} can receive different guideline schedules because their new leases begin on different dates.
realLife: New York City's 2023 order covered leases beginning from October 1 through the following September 30. The start date determined whether a lease fell in that window.
gates: The case record identifies the both lease start dates and the order's coverage window.
inGame: needs: both lease start dates and the order's coverage window.

turns.what: The neighbors compare the same year's schedule.
turns.pulledBy: Both starts fall in the window

turns.what: The clerk looks up the order for that lease date.
turns.pulledBy: One start falls outside the window
